title: Faithful Grounded Quote
initial_prompt: Summarize the API throughput and latency numbers from perf_report.txt.
speaker: Security Architect
candidate_message: According to perf_report.txt, the PaymentGateway API sustained 5,000 requests per second with a p99 latency of 42ms under load.

evidence.content: PaymentGateway API Benchmark: sustained throughput 5,000 requests per second, p99 latency 42ms, error rate 0.01%.

notes: Exact factual figures match retrieved evidence.

title: Faithful Paraphrase
initial_prompt: Explain our incident token invalidation SLA.
speaker: Security Architect
candidate_message: Per our security policy, any compromised API token must be revoked within a quarter of an hour once detected and escalated to security leads.

evidence.content: Incident Reporting: Report suspected token leaks immediately to security leads. Invalidate compromised tokens within 15 minutes of detection.

notes: 15 minutes accurately paraphrased as a quarter of an hour.

title: Faithful Honest Uncertainty
initial_prompt: Check sla_doc.txt and tell me the disaster recovery RTO and the exact annual AWS bill.
speaker: ROI Strategist
candidate_message: The sla_doc.txt specifies a disaster recovery RTO of 30 minutes, but the retrieved document does not state the annual AWS bill.

evidence.content: Disaster Recovery Policy: Target RTO is 30 minutes and RPO is 5 minutes across primary and secondary availability zones.

notes: Agent explicitly states missing information instead of guessing.

title: Faithful Open-Ended Opinion
initial_prompt: Compare monolith vs modular microservices for a 6-person engineering team.
speaker: Visionary
candidate_message: For a six-person team, starting with a well-bounded modular monolith minimizes operational overhead, distributed tracing tax, and deployment complexity while preserving clear domain seams for future extraction.
notes: Open-ended architectural advice without fabricated quotes or evidence.

title: Faithful Peer Citation
initial_prompt: Evaluate single-region vs multi-region active-active failover.
speaker: Tactician
candidate_message: Building on Visionary's point that multi-region active-active failover eliminates single-region outage blast radius, we should stage DNS health checks and conflict resolution first.

prior_assistant_messages.content: [Visionary]: We should adopt multi-region active-active failover to eliminate single-region outage blast radius and meet strict availability targets.

title: Faithful Constraint Adherence
initial_prompt: Design a caching layer using only SQLite and in-process LRU memory. Do NOT recommend Redis or Memcached.
speaker: Innovator
candidate_message: We can pair a bounded in-process LRU cache for hot reads with a dedicated SQLite WAL table indexed by cache key and TTL expiration timestamps, avoiding external cache daemons completely.
notes: Strictly obeys user negative constraint against Redis/Memcached.

title: Hallucinated Throughput Metric
initial_prompt: Summarize the API throughput and latency numbers from perf_report.txt.
speaker: Security Architect
candidate_message: According to perf_report.txt, the PaymentGateway API achieved 99,000 requests per second with sub-2ms p99 latency and zero errors.

evidence.content: PaymentGateway API Benchmark: sustained throughput 5,000 requests per second, p99 latency 42ms, error rate 0.01%.

notes: Fabricates 99,000 rps and sub-2ms p99 directly contradicting 5,000 rps and 42ms in evidence.

title: Violated User Constraint
initial_prompt: Design a zero-external-dependency caching layer in Python. Do NOT recommend Redis or MongoDB.
speaker: Innovator
candidate_message: The optimal solution is to deploy a Redis cluster in front of MongoDB to handle all session caching and TTL eviction.
notes: Directly violates explicit user prohibition against Redis and MongoDB.

title: Contradicted SLA Retention
initial_prompt: What is our audit log retention period according to compliance_policy.txt?
speaker: Legal Advisor
candidate_message: Per compliance_policy.txt, all audit logs are purged permanently after 7 days to minimize storage overhead.

evidence.content: Audit Log Policy: Security and financial audit logs must be retained immutably for at least 365 days before archival or deletion.

notes: Claims 7 days when retrieved evidence mandates at least 365 days.

title: Peer Misattribution
initial_prompt: Evaluate single-region vs multi-region active-active failover.
speaker: Tactician
candidate_message: As Visionary explicitly argued earlier, we must abandon multi-region failover completely and deploy everything on a single bare-metal server.

prior_assistant_messages.content: [Visionary]: We should adopt multi-region active-active failover to eliminate single-region outage blast radius and meet strict availability targets.

notes: Attributes the exact opposite stance to Visionary.

title: Invented Compliance Certification
initial_prompt: List our current security certifications from vendor_security.txt.
speaker: Security Architect
candidate_message: Based on vendor_security.txt, our platform holds active FedRAMP High Authorization and PCI-DSS Level 1 certification.

evidence.content: Compliance Status: Currently certified for SOC 2 Type I only. ISO 27001 and PCI-DSS assessments are not yet started, and FedRAMP is out of scope.

notes: Claims FedRAMP High and PCI-DSS Level 1 when evidence explicitly states SOC 2 Type I only.

title: Reversed Cost Comparison
initial_prompt: Compare Option A vs Option B pricing from pricing_sheet.txt.
speaker: ROI Strategist
candidate_message: According to pricing_sheet.txt, Option A is eight times cheaper than Option B per thousand requests, making Option A the lowest-cost choice.

evidence.content: Pricing Comparison: Option A costs $0.40 per 1,000 requests; Option B costs $0.05 per 1,000 requests.
